frases.dice: In the C4 dataset, a single sixty-one word sentence appeared more than sixty thousand times.
frases.muestra: In the C4 dataset, a single 61-word sentence appeared more than 60,000 times.
frases.es: En el dataset C4, una sola frase de 61 palabras aparecía más de 60.000 veces.

frases.dice: After removing duplicates, models emitted memorized text ten times less often.
frases.muestra: After removing duplicates, models emitted memorized text 10× less often.
frases.es: Al quitar los duplicados, los modelos repitieron texto memorizado diez veces menos.

frases.dice: Tech capsule: data curation and synthetic data.
frases.muestra: Tech capsule: data curation and synthetic data.
frases.es: Cápsula técnica: curación de datos y datos sintéticos.

frases.dice: First, how do you tell if two texts are near duplicates? You cut them into three-word pieces, called shingles.
frases.muestra: First, how do you tell if two texts are near duplicates? You cut them into three-word pieces, called shingles.
frases.es: ¿Cómo se mide si dos textos son casi iguales? Los cortas en trozos de tres palabras, llamados shingles.

frases.dice: Jack-card similarity is the shared pieces divided by all distinct pieces. In this example, eight out of eleven: zero point seven three.
frases.muestra: Jaccard similarity is the shared pieces divided by all distinct pieces. In this example, 8 out of 11: 0.73.
frases.es: La similitud de Jaccard es los trozos en común dividido por todos los trozos distintos. En este ejemplo, 8 de 11: 0,73.

frases.dice: But with a billion documents, comparing every pair means five times ten to the seventeen comparisons. It grows as n squared.
frases.muestra: But with a billion documents, comparing every pair means 5 · 10¹⁷ comparisons. It grows as n².
frases.es: Pero con mil millones de documentos, comparar todos los pares son 5 · 10¹⁷ comparaciones. Crece como n².

frases.dice: Here's the MinHash trick. Order the pieces with a random hash function and keep the minimum. The probability that two texts share that minimum is exactly their Jack-card similarity.
frases.muestra: Here's the MinHash trick: order the pieces with a random hash and keep the minimum. The probability that two texts share that minimum is exactly their Jaccard similarity.
frases.es: El truco de MinHash: ordenas los trozos con una función hash al azar y te quedas con el mínimo. La probabilidad de que dos textos compartan ese mínimo es exactamente su similitud de Jaccard.

frases.dice: With one hundred twenty-eight hash functions, each document becomes a short signature, and the estimate is off by about three points.
frases.muestra: With 128 hash functions, each document becomes a short signature, and the estimate is off by about 3 points.
frases.es: Con 128 funciones hash, cada documento queda resumido en una firma corta, y el error de la estimación ronda los 3 puntos.

frases.dice: To avoid comparing signatures pairwise, you use bands, called LSH. Split the signature into twenty bands of five values, and only compare documents that match in some band.
frases.muestra: To avoid comparing signatures pairwise, use bands (LSH): split the signature into 20 bands of 5 values, and only compare documents that match in some band.
frases.es: Para no comparar firmas de a pares se usan bandas (LSH): divides la firma en 20 bandas de 5 valores, y solo comparas documentos que coinciden en alguna banda.

frases.dice: At similarity zero point eight, the chance of becoming candidates is ninety-nine point nine six percent. At zero point three, under five percent. The cost becomes nearly linear.
frases.muestra: At similarity 0.8, the chance of becoming candidates is 99.96%. At 0.3, under 5%. The cost becomes nearly linear.
frases.es: Con similitud 0,8, la probabilidad de ser candidatos es 99,96%. Con 0,3, menos del 5%. El costo pasa a ser casi lineal.

frases.dice: How much data do you need? The Chinchilla study showed that, for fixed compute, data and parameters should grow together: about twenty tokens per parameter.
frases.muestra: How much data do you need? The Chinchilla study showed that, for fixed compute, data and parameters should grow together: about 20 tokens per parameter.
frases.es: ¿Cuántos datos necesitas? El estudio Chinchilla mostró que, con un cómputo fijo, datos y parámetros deben crecer juntos: unos 20 tokens por parámetro.

frases.dice: Its seventy billion parameter model used one point four trillion tokens. And the mix matters too: how much weight goes to web, code, or books is a hyperparameter.
frases.muestra: Its 70-billion-parameter model used 1.4 trillion tokens. And the mix matters too: how much weight goes to web, code, or books is a hyperparameter.
frases.es: Su modelo de 70.000 millones de parámetros usó 1,4 billones de tokens. Y la mezcla también importa: cuánto pesa la web, el código o los libros es un hiperparámetro.

frases.dice: When data runs short, you make it. Evol Instruct asks a model to rewrite instructions: deeper, with constraints and reasoning steps, or broader, with new topics.
frases.muestra: When data runs short, you make it. Evol-Instruct asks a model to rewrite instructions: deeper (constraints, reasoning steps) or broader (new topics).
frases.es: Cuando faltan datos, se fabrican. Evol-Instruct le pide a un modelo reescribir instrucciones: más profundas (restricciones, pasos de razonamiento) o más amplias (temas nuevos).

frases.dice: But many synthetic answers are wrong. So a verifier model filters the traces. And this is where Bayes comes in.
frases.muestra: But many synthetic answers are wrong. So a verifier model filters the traces. This is where Bayes comes in.
frases.es: Pero muchas respuestas sintéticas están mal. Por eso un modelo verificador filtra las trazas. Y aquí entra Bayes.

frases.dice: If the generator is right sixty percent of the time, and the verifier passes ninety in a hundred correct answers, but also twenty in a hundred wrong ones, what passes the filter is correct eighty-seven percent of the time.
frases.muestra: If the generator is right 60% of the time, and the verifier passes 90 in 100 correct answers but also 20 in 100 wrong ones, what passes is correct 87% of the time.
frases.es: Si el generador acierta 60%, y el verificador aprueba 90 de cada 100 correctas pero también 20 de cada 100 incorrectas, lo que pasa el filtro es correcto en un 87%.

frases.dice: That's Bayes' rule: the prior, sixty percent, is updated by the evidence that it passed the filter.
frases.muestra: That's Bayes' rule: the prior (60%) is updated by the evidence that it passed the filter.
frases.es: Es la regla de Bayes: la creencia previa (60%) se actualiza con la evidencia de que pasó el filtro.

frases.dice: But careful: if you train again and again on data you generated yourself, the tails of the distribution vanish. It's called model collapse.
frases.muestra: Careful: if you train again and again on data you generated yourself, the tails of the distribution vanish. It's called model collapse.
frases.es: Ojo: si entrenas una y otra vez con datos que tú mismo generaste, las colas de la distribución desaparecen. Se llama colapso del modelo.

frases.dice: In a simple simulation, a normal distribution refit on twenty samples per generation loses three quarters of its spread in fifty generations. The cure: always mix in real data.
frases.muestra: In a simple simulation, a normal refit on 20 samples per generation loses three quarters of its spread in 50 generations. The cure: always mix in real data.
frases.es: En una simulación simple, una normal reajustada con 20 muestras por generación pierde tres cuartos de su dispersión en 50 generaciones. La cura: mezclar siempre datos reales.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud: Dataflow runs the cleaning pipeline, Big Query stores the signatures and finds duplicates, and Vertex AI generates and verifies synthetic data.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud: Dataflow runs the cleaning pipeline, BigQuery stores signatures and finds duplicates, and Vertex AI generates and verifies synthetic data.
frases.es: En Google Cloud: Dataflow ejecuta el pipeline de limpieza, BigQuery guarda las firmas y encuentra duplicados, y Vertex AI genera y verifica los datos sintéticos.

frases.dice: Now you have the basics. MinHash turns comparing texts into comparing signatures. LSH avoids the quadratic cost. And synthetic data needs a verifier, plus real data in the mix.
frases.muestra: The basics: MinHash turns comparing texts into comparing signatures. LSH avoids the quadratic cost. Synthetic data needs a verifier, plus real data in the mix.
frases.es: Con esto tienes las bases: MinHash convierte comparar textos en comparar firmas. LSH evita el costo cuadrático. Y lo sintético necesita un verificador y datos reales en la mezcla.

frases.muestra: If this helped, share and follow.
frases.es: Si te sirvió, compártelo y sígueme.
